description: Discover the best hotels in Kuta, Indonesia. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Family-Friendly Hard Rock Bali Five-Star Escape
hotels.description: Dive headfirst into the ultimate family escape at the recently renovated Hard Rock Hotel Bali, a fun-filled, eco-friendly rock 'n' roll resort, just steps from famous Kuta Beach, ranked within the top 10% of properties on Tripadvisor and certified by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC). Whether you’re looking to chill out or rock out, big and little kids alike have everything they need for an incredible stay, jam-packed with entertainment. Adults can relax in a poolside cabana or unwind in the Rock Spa, while the kids play games and make new friends at Roxity Kids' Club (for ages 4-12) or splash around in the waterpark. Fitness enthusiasts can work out at Body Rock Gym or try out the five-metre rock climbing wall, while teens can hang out in the ultra-cool TABU venue, complete with a multipurpose DJ booth, pool table, and PlayStation 4. Venture into Kuta for buzzing bars and restaurants, surf or sunbathe at Kuta Beach, or treat the family to a fun day out at Waterbom Bali, an action-packed water park with rides and dining options.

hotels.title: Stylish Kuta Beachfront Escape with Rooftop Pool, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Free-Flow Cocktail Hour
hotels.description: Discover unique, design-driven luxury with a stylish stay on Kuta Beach, framed by showstopping views of the shimmering Indian Ocean. This calypso-cool, social club-inspired retreat - part of the renowned Accor Hotels - has everything you need for an unforgettable escape, all just steps from the golden shores of one of Bali’s best beaches. After days spent soaking up Kuta Beach’s legendary sun, surf and sand, return to the hotel’s rooftop for laid-back bites and beanbag sessions at Afterglow Bar & Kitchen, or admire each spectacular sunset by the stunning infinity pool. When you’re ready to explore, Kuta is a traveller’s playground with countless adventures - you’ll be moments away from the boutique-filled open-air gardens of Beachwalk Shopping Centre, and countless eclectic treasures at Kuta and Legian art markets.

hotels.title: Kuta's #1 Resort: Bali Beachfront Oasis with Massages, Daily Breakfast & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Discover family-friendly, five-star bliss at this tropical oasis, magnificently positioned on Bali's golden shores. Consistently rated among Kuta's top hotels, it's easy to see why this beachside gem is the pinnacle of relaxed seclusion. This stylish hideaway boasts five spectacular outdoor pools, sprawling lush green gardens, and multiple onsite dining options plating favourites from Indonesia and beyond. For world-class wellness treatments, Sakanti Spa is on hand to make this a quintessential Balinese holiday, all just moments away from vibrant shopping precincts, bustling restaurants, local eateries and Jerman Beach, one of Bali's most stunning sunset-facing strips. The ANVAYA Beach Resort Bali perfectly balances family-friendly fun with opulence fit for the Island of the Gods. Kids will enjoy splashing in the pools, building sandcastles on the private beach or learning about Balinese culture at the ANVAYA Kids' Club while adults indulge in poolside cocktails or a blissful massage at the serene spa.

hotels.title: Comfortable Kuta Stay with Onsite Bar & Restaurant
hotels.description: Step into the heart of Kuta with a stay at this comfortable retreat, with the lively energy of Kuta Beach and Waterbon Bali's thrilling slides nearby. Whether it's for business or leisure, ibis Bali Kuta provides the perfect accommodation for a relaxing stay. After exploring the bustling local markets or catching a sunset at the beach, recharge with international and Indonesian favourites at Rendez-Vous or enjoy a casual drink at the onsite bar.
